⚙️ Chapter 3: In-Depth Analysis of All Tab Functions

[Standard Pipeline] (Tabs 1~6)

  • 1. Deep Search & Autofill: Traverse game files, decrypt, and generate a CSV dictionary mapping "Hash gibberish ↔ Card ID/Name".
  • 2. Find Files: Read extraction list (visual filtering supported), copy target files from the 0000 directory to the project's [Original Files] area.
  • 3. Extract Data: Unpack Bundles, export [Original Art], and retain original [File Backups].
  • 4. Change Card Art: Inject new images from [Modified Cards] into Bundles, output to [Modified Files].
  • 5. Pack Mod: Automatically build subdirectories complying with official path rules and compress into a ZIP.
  • 6. Smart Chained Execution: Automatically execute steps 2 to 5 in sequence with one click.

[Core Soul Engine] Advanced Card Art Breakthrough & Extreme Effects (Tabs 7, 8, 9)

  • 7. Pendulum & Over-Frame Art Post-Processing (Digital Image Processing Center):
    - Pendulum Processing: Automatically fill transparent pixels to prevent game stretching/distortion.
    - Over-Frame 3D Processing: Apply 11:16 templates, supporting -ch (character) and -bg (background) dual-layer intersection cutout, perfectly solving foil effects piercing through characters.
    - Spine Summon Animation Generation: Support green screen chroma key, pack videos/PSD into an Atlas, and auto-calculate POP UP scaling to translate into Spine bones.
  • 8. Quick Single Card Mod (Express Line):
    Skip the project creation process; input ID and image for direct injection. Forms a Golden Loop with Tab 7 and Tab 9 (Over-frame processing ➔ Injection ➔ Whitelist registration).
  • 9. Over-Frame Card Register (Binary Whitelist Editor):
    The absolute key to activating over-frame art! If the Card ID is not written into the of_card_asset whitelist here, 11:16 artworks will be severely squeezed and distorted.

[Exploration, Maintenance & Management] (Tabs 10~13)

  • 10. Graphical Browser: Ignore gibberish hashes and view visual assets like playmats, sleeves, and icons via thumbnails.
  • 11. Mod Stream Fixer: When major official updates break old mods, force transplant old textures into new original files.
  • 12. Virtual Mod Manager: Based on system Symlink technology. Mount and unmount with zero latency without moving files (Admin privileges required).
  • 13. Settings & Appearance: Global control center. Customize UI colors, background transparency, and left sidebar tab sorting.

📦 Chapter 1: Preparation & Naming Rules

1. Prepare Replacement Assets:
Static images support PNG (recommended, retains alpha channel), JPG, BMP, etc.; Summon animations support MP4, AVI, MOV videos, GIF animations, or PSD layer files.

2. Strict File Naming Rules (Regex Matching):
The system reads the string from left to right and extracts the characters before the first separator (such as an underscore _) as the "Object ID".
An incorrect prefix ID will cause the system to silently ignore the file. Please strictly adhere to the following examples:

  • ✅ 12345_AnyRemarkText.png (Standard recommended format, system accurately extracts 12345)
  • ✅ 12345.png (Pure number ID)
  • ✅ 12345-ch.png / 12345-bg.png (For advanced dual-layer over-frame: character layer and background layer)
  • ✅ p18532_AnimationRemark.mp4 (Summon animation exclusive: must start with lowercase p followed by numbers)
  • ✅ ShopBGBase02_Lobby.png (System large file asset: original official code must be fully retained)

❌ Wrong Examples (Will cause matching failure):
BlueEyesWhiteDragon_12345.png (ID is placed at the back), 12345CardArt.png (Lacks a separator character).
